verdict.rationale: First-party docs say every account has a Personal vault synced across all devices. Vaults are end-to-end encrypted cloud storage for Hosts, Keys, Snippets, Port Forwarding rules and Known Hosts, and logging in on another device syncs vaults, hosts and configurations automatically, across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android. Data is also stored locally, so connections work without internet. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that cross-device sync works reliably, and documentation of how offline edits and sync conflicts are handled.
